direction.content_form: Two substantial left action views are bridged by a printed page; an unequal right factual matrix begins with date/time rather than a large title.
direction.whole_expression_style: Bright civic editorial collage: realistic actions interrupt orthogonal modules. Geometric timing, warmer Korean identity and expressive page capitals have distinct jobs.
direction.reference_transfer: SABF: unequal identity/fact/repetition/photo modules change hierarchy. Rebuild one complete landscape with action images instead of landmarks/identity letters. Mut supplies the shared-event attendance relation.

layout.large_relationship: Left 43%: close printing window [24,24,302,139] and wider reading window [24,244,302,137], bridged by substantial paper. Right 48%: date/time, event/activity, six attendance rows. No arrow or tiny connecting icon.
layout.alignment: Right blocks share x350. English is horizontal on the central bridging paper, with generous margins.
layout.visible_reading_route: First large date/time upper right; directly below, Korean name/activity. Continue down the same column to venue, entry, fee, application, preparation and welcome. The left shared page connects two actions without explanatory new labels.

typography.roles: Date/time: geometric tabular sans 27/28 px. Korean title: humanist medium sans 30 px; activity 19 px. Facts: open regular sans 17 px/23 px rows. Page English: wide slab-like display capitals 27 px, distinct from support text.
typography.image_type_boundary: Facts occupy flat modules. English appears only on the linking page; photo edges/fingers remain outside words.

image.scene: Upper close photo view: adult hand lifts inked carved rubber slab, exposing fresh paper impression. Lower wider view: two adult neighbours jointly hold and read that page, one speaking and one following its visible English.
image.action_relation: One substantial page cutout bridges the views; a unique nonletter relief pattern matches block, fresh imprint and carried sheet. Both faces and paper-supporting hands remain visible. This is two related views, with no invented chronological programme or pseudo-print.
image.crop: Upper crop retains wrist, gripping fingers, slab thickness and whole mark. Lower includes both faces and grips; no orphan hands. Page wording stays nearly frontal.

direction.material: Precise photo cutouts with consistent light plus flat civic fields. Functional paper, without distressed scraps or invented microprint.
direction.color: Cobalt, light coral and ivory modules; navy copy and ordinary warm skin tones. Colour separates timing, identity and joining.
direction.emotion: Public, energetic adult community culture, easy to join without children’s craft cues.

copy_groups.line_plan: 1 row per entry; 42/25 px boxes; widths ≈231/210 px.

copy_groups.purpose: Printed page carried between action views

copy_groups.line_plan: 6 rows at 23 px; height ≈132 px; widest ≈226 of 336 px.

nearest_direction_difference.stripped_material_color_test: M2 keeps stacked left action windows, bridging page and date-first right matrix. M4 keeps one full-width panoramic scene, upper title/timing and lower three-column facts. Image boundaries and reading direction differ before photo treatment or colour.

common_constraints: Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.

Rubber-block printing onto paper and shared reading of that printed work must be visibly connected, with an approachable adult cultural-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720.

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
